svg.text: The Teensy writes the Adafruit 2090 over an 8-bit bus and reads its touch controller over I²C through a level converter. A flat flex cable carries both from the display board to the module.
at most 197 mA for the module
seen from the screen side, in landscape
Adafruit 2090, 2.8" TFT with capacitive touch, ILI9341 and CST026
Adafruit 757, bidirectional logic level converter, BSS138
QUARKZMAN flat flex cable, type B
